condition.description: 1-D array of bools Array that selects which entries to return. If len(condition) is less than the size of `a` along the given axis, then output is truncated to the length of the condition array.

a.description: array_like Array from which to extract a part.

axis.description: int, optional Axis along which to take slices. If None (default), work on the flattened array.

out.description: ndarray, optional Output array. Its type is preserved and it must be of the right shape to hold the output.

output.description: ------- ndarray A copy of `a` without the slices along axis for which `condition` is false.
